A '''Sullustan''' lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. They had [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. The Sullustan was dressed in a short-sleeved, multi-colored, patterned [[shirt]] with a circular symbol on the lapel&mdash;their lucky [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]]. The garment was worn over a dark, long-sleeved undershirt and paired with dark slacks and a black [[Belt/Legends|belt]].<ref name="LS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sullustan was depicted on the "Lucky Shirt" card for the ''[[Threat of the Conqueror]]'' expansion card set for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'', released in [[2010]].<ref name="LS" />
